query:
SELECT 
  p.id,
  p.nameAr,
  p.nameEn,
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM product_categories c WHERE c.parentId = p.id) as subcategories_count
FROM product_categories p
WHERE p.parentId IS NULL
ORDER BY p.`order`;
